title: util.isString has been removed
summary: Node.js removed util.isString() (DEP0045 to DEP0058 group, end-of-life since v23.0.0), so calls throw a TypeError.

sources.title: Node.js deprecations: DEP0045 to DEP0058 util.is* functions

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and error handling differences.

steps.title: Replace util.isString
steps.instructions: Replace each reported util.isString(x) with typeof x === 'string'.

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.
